name: powerpages-traditional-site
description: Community-authored (Zero to Hero) Power Pages Traditional (non-code) site toolkit — noun-named pp-* skills for provisioning, building, integrating, and securing Power Pages sites on the enhanced Dataverse data model (mspp_* tables + powerpagecomponent). Content via the Dataverse Web API: web pages, page templates, web templates, web files, content snippets, navigation (web links, site markers, redirects), basic/multistep forms and lists, server logic, Liquid, Web API. Access & security: web roles, table + column permissions, page access rules, security headers/CSP, WAF, security review. Site & platform lifecycle via the pac pages / pac power-pages CLI: website provisioning, standard→enhanced data-model migration, download/upload (ALM), Bootstrap 3→5 migration, and cache flush. The traditional-site counterpart to Microsoft's code-site plugin.
